cards.name: Tri-Horned Dragon
cards.text: An unworthy dragon with three sharp horns sprouting from its head.

cards.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
cards.text: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

cards.name: Hitotsu-Me Giant
cards.text: A one-eyed behemoth with thick, powerful arms made for delivering punishing blows.

cards.name: Flame Swordsman
cards.text: "Flame Manipulator" + "Masaki the Legendary Swordsman"

cards.name: Skull Servant
cards.text: A skeletal ghost that isn't strong but can mean trouble in large numbers.

cards.name: Dark Magician
cards.text: ''The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.''

cards.name: Gaia The Fierce Knight
cards.text: ''A knight whose horse travels faster than the wind. His battle-charge is a force to be reckoned with.''

cards.name: Celtic Guardian
cards.text: An elf who learned to wield a sword, he baffles enemies with lightning-swift attacks.

cards.name: Basic Insect
cards.text: Usually found traveling in swarms, this creature's ideal environment is the forest.

cards.name: Mammoth Graveyard
cards.text: A mammoth that protects the graves of its pack and is absolutely merciless when facing grave-robbers.

cards.name: Silver Fang
cards.text: A snow wolf that's beautiful to the eye, but absolutely vicious in battle.

cards.name: Dark Gray
cards.text: Entirely gray, this beast has rarely been seen by mortal eyes.

cards.name: Trial of Nightmare
cards.text: This fiend passes judgment on enemies that are locked in coffins.

cards.name: Nemuriko
cards.text: A child-like creature that controls a sleep fiend to beckon enemies into eternal slumber.

cards.name: The 13th Grave
cards.text: A zombie that suddenly appeared from plot #13 - an empty grave.

cards.name: Charubin the Fire Knight
cards.text: "Monster Egg" + "Hinotama Soul"

cards.name: Flame Manipulator
cards.text: This Spellcaster attacks enemies with fire-related spells such as "Sea of Flames" and "Wall of Fire".

cards.name: Monster Egg
cards.text: A warrior hidden within an egg that attacks enemies by flinging eggshells.

cards.name: Firegrass
cards.text: A fire-breathing plant found growing near volcanoes.

cards.name: Darkfire Dragon
cards.text: "Firegrass" + "Petit Dragon"

cards.name: Dark King of the Abyss
cards.text: It's said that this King of the Netherworld once had the power to rule over the dark.

cards.name: Fiend Reflection #2
cards.text: A bird-beast that summons reinforcements with a hand mirror.

cards.name: Fusionist
cards.text: "Petit Angel" + "Mystical Sheep #2"

cards.name: Turtle Tiger
cards.text: A tiger encased in a protective shell that attacks with razor-sharp fangs.

cards.name: Petit Dragon
cards.text: A very small dragon known for its vicious attacks.

cards.name: Petit Angel
cards.text: A quick-moving and tiny fairy that's very difficult to hit.

cards.name: Hinotama Soul
cards.text: An intensely hot flame creature that rams anything standing in its way.

cards.name: Aqua Madoor
cards.text: A wizard of the waters that conjures a liquid wall to crush any enemies that oppose him.

cards.name: Kagemusha of the Blue Flame
cards.text: Serving as a double for the Ruler of the Blue Flame, he's a master swordsman that wields a fine blade.

cards.name: Flame Ghost
cards.text: "Skull Servant" + "Dissolverock"

cards.name: Two-Mouth Darkruler
cards.text: A dinosaur with two deadly jaws, it stores electricity in its horn and releases high voltage bolts from the mouth on its back.

cards.name: Dissolverock
cards.text: A monster born in the lava pits, it generates intense heat that can melt away its enemies.

cards.name: Root Water
cards.text: An amphibian capable of calling up a massive tidal wave from the dark seas to wipe out enemy monsters.

cards.name: The Furious Sea King
cards.text: Grand King of the Seven Seas, he's able to summon massive tidal waves to drown the enemy.

cards.name: Green Phantom King
cards.text: This youthful king of the forests lives in a green world, abundant with trees and wildlife.

cards.name: Ray & Temperature
cards.text: The Sun and the North Wind join hands to deliver a devastating combination of heat and gale-force winds.

cards.name: King Fog
cards.text: A fiend that dwells in a blinding curtain of smoke.

cards.name: Mystical Sheep #2
cards.text: A monstrous sheep with a long tail for hypnotizing enemies.

cards.name: Masaki the Legendary Swordsman
cards.text: Legendary swordmaster Masaki is a veteran of over 100 battles.

cards.name: Kurama
cards.text: A vicious bird that attacks from the skies with its whip-like tail.

cards.name: Legendary Sword
cards.text: Equip only to a Warrior monster. It gains 300 ATK/DEF.

cards.name: Beast Fangs
cards.text: A Beast-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

cards.name: Violet Crystal
cards.text:
(This card is not treated as a "Crystal" card.)
Equip only to a Zombie monster. It gains 300 ATK/DEF.

cards.name: Book of Secret Arts
cards.text: A Spellcaster-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

cards.name: Power of Kaishin
cards.text: Equip only to an Aqua monster. It gains 300 ATK/DEF.

cards.name: Dragon Capture Jar
cards.text: Change all face-up Dragon-Type monsters on the field to Defense Position, also they cannot change their battle positions.

cards.name: Forest
cards.text: All Insect, Beast, Plant, and Beast-Warrior monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

cards.name: Wasteland
cards.text: All Dinosaur, Zombie, and Rock monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

cards.name: Mountain
cards.text: All Dragon, Winged Beast, and Thunder monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

cards.name: Sogen
cards.text: All Warrior and Beast-Warrior monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

cards.name: Umi
cards.text: All Fish, Sea Serpent, Thunder, and Aqua monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF, also all Machine and Pyro monsters on the field lose 200 ATK/DEF.

cards.name: Yami
cards.text: All Fiend and Spellcaster monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF, also all Fairy monsters on the field lose 200 ATK/DEF.

cards.name: Dark Hole
cards.text: Destroy all monsters on the field.

cards.name: Raigeki
cards.text: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

cards.name: Red Medicine
cards.text: Increase your Life Points by 500 points.

cards.name: Sparks
cards.text: Inflict 200 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

cards.name: Hinotama
cards.text: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

cards.name: Fissure
cards.text: Destroy the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied).

cards.name: Trap Hole
cards.text: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons 1 monster with 1000 or more ATK: Target that monster; destroy that target.

cards.name: Polymerization
cards.text: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material.

cards.name: Remove Trap
cards.text: Select 1 face-up Trap Card on the field and destroy it.

cards.name: Two-Pronged Attack
cards.text: Select and destroy 2 of your monsters and 1 of your opponent's monsters.

cards.name: Mystical Elf
cards.text: A delicate elf that lacks offense, but has a terrific defense backed by mystical power.

cards.name: Tyhone
cards.text: Capable of firing cannonballs from its mouth for long-range attacks, this creature is particularly effective in mountain battles.

cards.name: Beaver Warrior
cards.text: What this creature lacks in size it makes up for in defense when battling in the prairie.

cards.name: Gravedigger Ghoul
cards.text: Select up to 2 Monster Card(s) from your opponent's Graveyard. Remove the selected card(s) from play.

cards.name: Curse of Dragon
cards.text: A wicked dragon that taps into dark forces to execute a powerful attack.

cards.name: Karbonala Warrior
cards.text: "M-Warrior #1" + "M-Warrior #2"

cards.name: Giant Soldier of Stone
cards.text: A giant warrior made of stone. A punch from this creature has earth-shaking results.

cards.name: Uraby
cards.text: Fast on its feet, this dinosaur rips enemies to shreds with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Red-Eyes Black Dragon
cards.text: ''A ferocious dragon with a deadly attack.''

cards.name: Reaper of the Cards
cards.text: FLIP: Select 1 Trap Card on the field and destroy it. If the selected card is Set, pick up and see the card. If it is a Trap Card, it is destroyed. If it is a Spell Card, return it to its original position.

cards.name: Witty Phantom
cards.text: Dressed in a night-black tuxedo, this creature presides over the darkness.

cards.name: Larvas
cards.text: A fast-moving, bird-like creature that strangles opposing monsters with its long, thin arms.

cards.name: Hard Armor
cards.text: A living suit of armor that attacks enemies with a bone-jarring tackle.

cards.name: Man Eater
cards.text: Man-eating plant with poison feelers for attacking enemies.

cards.name: M-Warrior #1
cards.text: Specializing in combination attacks, this warrior uses magnetism to block an enemy's escape.

cards.name: M-Warrior #2
cards.text: Specializing in combination attacks, this warrior is equipped with a tough, magnetically coated armor.

cards.name: Spirit of the Harp
cards.text: A spirit that soothes the soul with the music of its heavenly harp.

cards.name: Armaill
cards.text: A strange warrior who manipulates three deadly blades with both hands and his tail.

cards.name: Terra the Terrible
cards.text: Known as a swamp dweller, this creature is a minion of the dark forces.

cards.name: Frenzied Panda
cards.text: A savage beast that carries a big bamboo stick for beating down its enemies.

cards.name: Kumootoko
cards.text: A massive, intelligent spider that traps enemies with webbing.

cards.name: Meda Bat
cards.text: An eyeball fiend created by a servant of the wicked, it uses "Dark Blasts" to blow away its enemies.

cards.name: Enchanting Mermaid
cards.text: A beautiful mermaid that lures voyagers to a watery grave.

cards.name: Fireyarou
cards.text: A malevolent creature wrapped in flames that attacks enemies with intense fire.

cards.name: Dragoness the Wicked Knight
cards.text: "Armaill" + "One-Eyed Shield Dragon"

cards.name: One-Eyed Shield Dragon
cards.text: This dragon wears a shield not only for its own protection, but also for ramming its enemies.

cards.name: Dark Energy
cards.text: Increase the ATK and DEF of a Fiend-Type monster equipped with this card by 300 points.

cards.name: Laser Cannon Armor
cards.text: Equip only to an Insect monster. It gains 300 ATK/DEF.

cards.name: Vile Germs
cards.text: A Plant-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

cards.name: Silver Bow and Arrow
cards.text: A Fairy-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

cards.name: Dragon Treasure
cards.text: A Dragon-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

cards.name: Electro-Whip
cards.text: Increase the ATK and DEF of a Thunder-Type monster equipped with this card by 300 points.

cards.name: Mystical Moon
cards.text: Equip only to a Beast-Warrior-Type monster. It gains 300 ATK and DEF.

cards.name: Stop Defense
cards.text: Select 1 Defense Position monster on your opponent's side of the field and change it to Attack Position.

cards.name: Machine Conversion Factory
cards.text: Equip only to a Machine monster. It gains 300 ATK/DEF.

cards.name: Raise Body Heat
cards.text: Equip only to a Dinosaur monster. It gains 300 ATK/DEF.

cards.name: Follow Wind
cards.text: Increase the ATK and DEF of a Winged Beast-Type monster equipped with this card by 300 points.

cards.name: Goblin's Secret Remedy
cards.text: Increase your Life Points by 600 points.

cards.name: Final Flame
cards.text: Inflict 600 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

cards.name: Swords of Revealing Light
cards.text: After this card's activation, it remains on the field, but you must destroy it during the End Phase of your opponent's 3rd turn. When this card is activated: If your opponent controls a face-down monster, flip all monsters they control face-up. While this card is face-up on the field, your opponent's monsters cannot declare an attack.

cards.name: Metal Dragon
cards.text: "Steel Ogre Grotto #1" + "Lesser Dragon"

cards.name: Spike Seadra
cards.text: Using the spikes sprouting from its body, this creature stabs its opponents and floods them with electricity.

cards.name: Tripwire Beast
cards.text: This creature attacks with electromagnetic waves.

cards.name: Skull Red Bird
cards.text: This monster swoops down and attacks with a rain of knives stored in its wings.

cards.name: Armed Ninja
cards.text: FLIP: Target 1 Spell Card on the field; destroy that target. (If the target is Set, reveal it, and destroy it if it is a Spell Card. Otherwise, return it to its original position.)

cards.name: Flower Wolf
cards.text: "Silver Fang" + "Darkworld Thorns"

cards.name: Man-Eater Bug
cards.text: FLIP: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

cards.name: Sand Stone
cards.text: Appears from underground and attacks with long, snake-like tentacles.

cards.name: Hane-Hane
cards.text: FLIP: Select 1 monster on the field and return it to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Misairuzame
cards.text: A missile-launching fish protected by deadly spikes.

cards.name: Steel Ogre Grotto #1
cards.text: A steel idol worshipped in the Land of Machines.

cards.name: Lesser Dragon
cards.text: A minor dragon incapable of breathing fire.

cards.name: Darkworld Thorns
cards.text: A thorny plant found in the darklands that wraps itself around any unwary traveler.

cards.name: Drooling Lizard
cards.text: A blood-sucking snake in human form that attacks any living being that passes nearby.

cards.name: Armored Starfish
cards.text: A bluish starfish with a solid hide capable of fending off attacks.

cards.name: Succubus Knight
cards.text: A warrior wizard adept in casting bone-chilling spells.

cards.name: Monster Reborn
cards.text: Target 1 monster in either GY; Special Summon it.

cards.name: Pot of Greed
cards.text: Draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Right Leg of the Forbidden One
cards.text: A forbidden right leg sealed by magic. Whosoever breaks this seal will know infinite power.

cards.name: Left Leg of the Forbidden One
cards.text: A forbidden left leg sealed by magic. Whosoever breaks this seal will know infinite power.

cards.name: Right Arm of the Forbidden One
cards.text: A forbidden right arm sealed by magic. Whosoever breaks this seal will know infinite power.

cards.name: Left Arm of the Forbidden One
cards.text: A forbidden left arm sealed by magic. Whosoever breaks this seal will know infinite power.

cards.name: Exodia the Forbidden One
cards.text: If you have "Right Leg of the Forbidden One", "Left Leg of the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One" and "Left Arm of the Forbidden One" in addition to this card in your hand, you win the Duel.

cards.name: Gaia the Dragon Champion
cards.text: "Gaia The Fierce Knight" + "Curse of Dragon"

cards.name: Feral Imp
cards.text: A playful little fiend that lurks in the dark, waiting to attack an unwary enemy.

cards.name: Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1
cards.text: A dragon commonly found guarding mountain fortresses. Its signature attack is a sweeping dive from out of the blue.

cards.name: Summoned Skull
cards.text:
A fiend with dark powers for confusing the enemy. Among the Fiend-Type monsters, this monster boasts considerable force.

(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)

cards.name: Great White
cards.text: A giant white shark with razor-sharp teeth.

cards.name: Dragon Zombie
cards.text: A dragon revived by sorcery. Its breath is highly corrosive.

cards.name: Doma The Angel of Silence
cards.text: This fairy rules over the end of existence.

cards.name: Ansatsu
cards.text: A silent and deadly warrior specializing in assassinations.

cards.name: Claw Reacher
cards.text: Stretching arms and razor-sharp claws make this monster a formidable opponent.

cards.name: Mystic Clown
cards.text: Nothing can stop the mad attack of this powerful creature.

cards.name: Sword of Dark Destruction
cards.text: Equip only to a DARK monster. It gains 400 ATK and loses 200 DEF.

cards.name: Dian Keto the Cure Master
cards.text: Increase your Life Points by 1000 points.

cards.name: Ancient Elf
cards.text: This elf is rumored to have lived for thousands of years. He leads an army of spirits against his enemies.

cards.name: Magical Ghost
cards.text: This creature casts a spell of terror and confusion just before attacking its enemies.

cards.name: De-Spell
cards.text: Target 1 face-up Spell, or 1 Set Spell/Trap, on the field; destroy that target if it is a Spell. (If the target is Set, reveal it.)

cards.name: Reinforcements
cards.text: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Change of Heart
cards.text: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase.

cards.name: The Stern Mystic
cards.text: FLIP: Reveal all face-down cards on the field (Flip Effects are not activated), then return them to their original positions.

cards.name: Wall of Illusion
cards.text: If this card is attacked by a monster, after damage calculation: Return that monster to the hand.

cards.name: Neo the Magic Swordsman
cards.text: A dimensional drifter who not only practices sorcery, but is also a sword and martial arts master.

cards.name: Baron of the Fiend Sword
cards.text: An aristocrat who wields a sword possessed by a malicious spirit that preys on the weak.

cards.name: Man-Eating Treasure Chest
cards.text: A monster disguised as a treasure chest that is known to attack the unwary adventurer.

cards.name: Sorcerer of the Doomed
cards.text: A slave of the dark arts, this sorcerer is a master of life-extinguishing spells.

cards.name: Last Will
cards.text: If a monster on your side of the field was sent to your Graveyard this turn, you can Special Summon 1 monster with an ATK of 1500 points or less from your Deck once during this turn. Then shuffle your Deck.

cards.name: Waboku

cards.text: Declare 1 Monster Card name. If the declared card is in your opponent's Deck, add 1 of that card to your opponent's hand.

cards.name: Card Shuffle
cards.text: Pay 300 Life Points to use this card's effect. Shuffle either your or your opponent's Deck. You can only use this effect during your turn, once per turn.

cards.name: Reasoning
cards.text: Your opponent declares a monster Level from 1 to 12. Excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set, then, if that monster is the same Level as the one declared by your opponent, send all excavated cards to the GY. If not, Special Summon the excavated monster, also send the remaining cards to the GY.

cards.name: Dark Room of Nightmare
cards.text: Each time your opponent takes damage from a card effect, except "Dark Room of Nightmare", inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

cards.name: Different Dimension Capsule
cards.text: Select 1 card from your Deck and remove it from play face-down. During your 2nd Standby Phase after activation, destroy this card and add the removed card to your hand.

cards.name: Necrovalley
cards.text: All "Gravekeeper's" monsters gain 500 ATK and DEF. Cards in the Graveyard cannot be banished. Negate any card effect that would move a card in the Graveyard to a different place. Negate any card effect that changes Types or Attributes in the Graveyard.

cards.name: Buster Rancher
cards.text: Only a monster with an ATK of 1000 points or less can be equipped with this card. During damage calculation, increase the ATK of the monster equipped with this card by 2500 points if the opponent's monster that battles it is in Attack Position and its ATK is 2500 or more, OR if the opponent's monster that battles it is in Defense Position and its DEF is 2500 or more.

cards.name: Hieroglyph Lithograph
cards.text: Pay 1000 Life Points. During the current Duel, your hand size limit becomes 7.

cards.name: Dark Snake Syndrome
cards.text: During each of your Standby Phases: Inflict damage to both players. This damage begins at 200 and is doubled during each of your following Standby Phases.

cards.name: Terraforming
cards.text: Add 1 Field Spell from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Banner of Courage
cards.text: All monsters you control gain 200 ATK during your Battle Phase only.

cards.name: Metamorphosis
cards.text: Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same Level as the Tributed monster.

cards.name: Royal Tribute
cards.text: If you control "Necrovalley": Both players discard any monsters in their hands.

cards.name: Reversal Quiz
cards.text: Send all cards in your hand and on your side of the field to the Graveyard. Call the type of card (Spell, Trap, or Monster) on top of your Deck. If you call it right, exchange your current Life Points with your opponent's current ones.

cards.name: Coffin Seller
cards.text: Each time a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

cards.name: Curse of Aging
cards.text: Discard 1 card from your hand. Decrease the ATK and DEF of all monsters on your opponent's side of the field by 500 points until the end of the turn this card is activated.

cards.name: Barrel Behind the Door
cards.text: Activate only when a card's effect that would inflict damage to you is activated. Your opponent takes the damage instead.

cards.name: Raigeki Break
cards.text: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

cards.name: Narrow Pass
cards.text: This card can only be activated when both players have 2 monsters or less on their respective sides of the field. Both players can only Normal Summon up to 2 additional monsters on their sides of the field.

cards.name: Disturbance Strategy
cards.text: Your opponent shuffles their entire hand into the Deck, then draws the same number of cards.

cards.name: Trap of Board Eraser
cards.text: You can only activate this card when an effect that inflicts damage to your Life Points is activated (except Battle Damage). Negate the Effect Damage you receive and your opponent then selects 1 card from his/her hand and discards it.

cards.name: Rite of Spirit
cards.text: Target 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target. This card's activation and effect are unaffected by "Necrovalley".

cards.name: Non Aggression Area
cards.text: You can only activate this card during your Standby Phase. Discard 1 card from your hand. Your opponent cannot Normal Summon, Set and/or Special Summon during his/her next turn.

cards.name: D. Tribe
cards.text: All monsters on your side of the field are treated as Dragon-Type until the End Phase of this turn.

cards.name: Byser Shock
cards.text: If this card is Summoned: Return all Set cards on the field to the hand.

cards.name: Question
cards.text: When activating this card, your opponent cannot check cards in the Graveyard. Your opponent calls the name of the first monster found at the bottom of your Graveyard. If he/she calls it right, the monster is removed from play. If he/she calls it wrong, the monster is Special Summoned to your side of the field.

cards.name: Rope of Life
cards.text: When a monster(s) is destroyed by battle and sent to your GY: Discard your entire hand (min.1), then target 1 of those monsters; Special Summon it, and if you do, it gains 800 ATK.

cards.name: Nightmare Wheel
cards.text: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster your opponent controls; it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. That monster must be on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

cards.name: Lava Golem
cards.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) to your opponent's field by Tributing 2 monsters they control. You cannot Normal Summon/Set the turn you Special Summon this card. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

cards.name: Dark Magician Girl
cards.text: Gains 300 ATK for every "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in the GY.

cards.name: People Running About
cards.text: Although they always suffer in silence, they swear an oath to inevitably revolt.

cards.name: Oppressed People
cards.text: They are oppressed, but believe they will have their freedom someday.

cards.name: United Resistance
cards.text: The people that gather to swear to fight their oppressors. A revolution is coming.

cards.name: X-Head Cannon
cards.text: A monster with a mighty cannon barrel, it is able to integrate its attacks. It attacks in many ways by combining and separating with other monsters.

cards.name: Y-Dragon Head
cards.text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "X-Head Cannon" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 400 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

cards.name: Z-Metal Tank
cards.text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "X-Head Cannon" or "Y-Dragon Head" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 600 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

cards.name: Dark Blade
cards.text: They say he is a dragon-manipulating warrior from the dark world. His attack is tremendous, using his great swords with vicious power.

cards.name: Pitch-Dark Dragon
cards.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field, you can equip it to your "Dark Blade" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, increase the ATK/DEF of the equipped monster by 400 points. When it attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

cards.name: Kiryu
cards.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field, you can equip it to your "Dark Blade" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, increase the ATK/DEF of the equipped monster by 900 points, and you can Tribute this card to allow the equipped monster to attack your opponent's Life Points directly this turn. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

cards.name: Decayed Commander
cards.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Zombie Tiger" from your hand. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Discard 1 random card from their hand.

cards.name: Zombie Tiger
cards.text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "Decayed Commander" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK/DEF. If the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Discard 1 random card from their hand. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

cards.name: Giant Orc
cards.text: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. You cannot change this battle position until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Second Goblin
cards.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Giant Orc" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, you can change the equipped monster's battle position once per turn. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

cards.name: Vampiric Orchis
cards.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Des Dendle" from your hand.

cards.name: Des Dendle
cards.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Vampiric Orchis" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, each time the equipped monster destroys 1 of your opponent's monsters, Special Summon 1 "Wicked Plant Token" (Plant-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 800/DEF 800). (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

cards.name: Burning Beast
cards.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Freezing Beast" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, each time the equipped monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, destroy 1 face-up Spell or Trap Card on the field. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

cards.name: Freezing Beast
cards.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Burning Beast" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, each time the equipped monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, destroy 1 face-down Spell or Trap Card on the field. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

cards.name: Union Rider
cards.text: You can take control of up to 1 Union Monster that is currently a monster on your opponent's side of the field, and equip it to this card. The Union Monster that is equipped to this card cannot be changed back to a monster using its own effect.

cards.name: D.D. Crazy Beast
cards.text: A monster that this card destroys as a result of battle is removed from play.

cards.name: Spell Canceller
cards.text: Spell Cards, and their effects on the field, cannot be activated. Negate all Spell effects on the field.

cards.name: Neko Mane King
cards.text: During your opponent's turn, when this card in your possession is sent to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: It becomes the End Phase of this turn.

cards.name: Helping Robo for Combat
cards.text: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Draw 1 card, then return 1 card from your hand to the bottom of the Deck.

cards.name: Dimension Jar
cards.text: FLIP: Both players can remove from play up to 3 monsters from their opponent's Graveyard.

cards.name: Great Phantom Thief
cards.text: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 card name; look at your opponent's hand, and if you do, discard all cards with that name in their hand.

cards.name: Roulette Barrel
cards.text: Once per turn: You can roll a six-sided die twice, choose 1 result, and destroy 1 monster on the field whose Level is equal to that result.

cards.name: Paladin of White Dragon
cards.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "White Dragon Ritual". At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that face-down monster. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand or Deck, but "Blue-Eyes White Dragons" cannot attack for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: White Dragon Ritual
cards.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Paladin of White Dragon". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 4 or more.

cards.name: Frontline Base
cards.text: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Union monster from your hand.

cards.name: Demotion
cards.text: Downgrade the monster equipped with this card by 2 Levels.

cards.name: Combination Attack
cards.text: During a Battle Phase, you can use this effect on 1 monster that has attacked this turn and is equipped with a Union Monster. Change the Union Monster back to a monster in face-up Attack or Defense Position. Also, the monster that was equipped with the Union Monster may attack again this turn.

cards.name: Kaiser Colosseum
cards.text: If there is 1 or more monster(s) on the field of the controller of this card, his/her opponent cannot place a monster on the field if his/her number of monsters would exceed the number of monsters that are on the field of this card's controller. The cards that are already on the field before this card's activation are unaffected by this effect.

cards.name: Autonomous Action Unit
cards.text: Pay 1500 Life Points, then target 1 monster in your opponent's Graveyard; Special Summon that target to your side of the field in face-up Attack Position, and equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

cards.name: Poison of the Old Man
Ante
cards.text: Each Player reveals 1 card from their hand. If one card is higher Level than the other, the card with the lower Level is sent to the Graveyard, and the player who revealed it takes 1000 damage. (Non-Monster Cards are treated as Level 0.)

cards.name: Dark Core
cards.text: Discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; banish that target.

cards.name: Raregold Armor
cards.text: As long as you control the monster equipped with this card, your opponent cannot attack other monsters other than the equipped monster.

cards.name: Metalsilver Armor
cards.text: As long as you control the monster equipped with this card, your opponent cannot use the effect of a Spell, Trap, or Effect Monster that targets 1 monster, except the equipped monster.

cards.name: Kishido Spirit
cards.text: Monsters on your side of the field cannot be destroyed in a battle if the monsters' ATK are equal.

cards.name: Tribute Doll
cards.text: Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 Level 7 monster from your hand that can be Normal Summoned/Set. It cannot attack this turn.

cards.name: Wave-Motion Cannon
cards.text: During your Main Phase: You can send this face-up card to the GY; inflict 1000 damage to your opponent for each of your Standby Phases that have passed since this card was activated.

cards.name: Huge Revolution
cards.text: This card can only be activated during your Main Phase when "People Running About", "Oppressed People", and "United Resistance" are face-up on your side of the field. Send all cards in your opponent's hand to the Graveyard and destroy all cards your opponent controls on the field.

cards.name: Thunder of Ruler
cards.text: During your opponent's Standby Phase: You can activate this card; there is no Battle Phase this turn.

cards.name: Spell Shield Type-8
cards.text:
Activate 1 of these effects.
● When a Spell Card is activated that targets exactly 1 monster on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.
● When a Spell Card is activated: Send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

cards.name: Meteorain
cards.text: During this turn, when your monsters attack with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

cards.name: Pineapple Blast
cards.text: When you Normal Summon a monster, if your opponent controls more monsters than you do: Destroy your opponent's monsters so that your opponent controls the same number of monsters as you (your opponent chooses which of their monsters are destroyed).

cards.name: Secret Barrel
cards.text: Inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand and for each card they control.

cards.name: Physical Double
cards.text: During your opponent's turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; Special Summon 1 "Mirage Token" with the same Level, Type, Attribute, ATK, and DEF as that target. Destroy this Token during the End Phase.

cards.name: Rivalry of Warlords
cards.text: Each player can only control 1 Type of monster. Send all other face-up monsters they control to the GY.

cards.name: Formation Union
cards.text:
Select and activate 1 of the following effects:
● Equip 1 Union Monster on your side of the field to an appropriate monster on your side of the field as an Equip Spell Card.
● Unequip 1 of your equipped Union Monsters and Special Summon it to your side of the field in face-up Attack Position.

cards.name: Adhesion Trap Hole
cards.text: When your opponent Summons a monster(s): Halve that monster(s)'s original ATK.

cards.name: XY-Dragon Cannon
cards.text:
"X-Head Cannon" + "Y-Dragon Head"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

cards.name: XYZ-Dragon Cannon
cards.text:
"X-Head Cannon" + "Y-Dragon Head" + "Z-Metal Tank"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

cards.name: XZ-Tank Cannon
cards.text:
"X-Head Cannon" + "Z-Metal Tank"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-down Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

cards.name: YZ-Tank Dragon
cards.text:
"Y-Dragon Head" + "Z-Metal Tank"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-down monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

cards.name: Great Angus
cards.text: A very violent beast, it is always berserk. People say that they have never seen it silent.

cards.name: Aitsu
cards.text: He seems to be very unreliable, but he might have incredible potential.

cards.name: Sonic Duck
cards.text: A duck which can walk at a sonic speed. Sometimes, he cannot deal with his incredible pace and loses control.

cards.name: Luster Dragon
cards.text: A very beautiful dragon covered with sapphire. It does not like fights, but has incredibly high attack power.

cards.name: Amazoness Paladin
cards.text: This card gains 100 ATK for each "Amazoness" monster you control.

cards.name: Amazoness Fighter
cards.text: You take no battle damage from attacks involving this card.

cards.name: Amazoness Swords Woman
cards.text: Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card instead.

cards.name: Amazoness Blowpiper
cards.text: Select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls during each of your Standby Phases. It loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Amazoness Tiger
cards.text: You can only control 1 "Amazoness Tiger". This card gains 400 ATK for each "Amazoness" monster you control. Your opponent cannot attack any face-up "Amazoness" monsters, except this one.

cards.name: Skilled White Magician
cards.text: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves (max. 3). You can Tribute this card with 3 Spell Counters on it; Special Summon 1 "Buster Blader" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

cards.name: Skilled Dark Magician
cards.text: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell resolves (max. 3). You can Tribute this card with 3 Spell Counters on it; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

cards.name: Apprentice Magician
cards.text: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on; place 1 Spell Counter on that target. If this card is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Spellcaster monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

cards.name: Old Vindictive Magician
cards.text: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

cards.name: Chaos Command Magician
cards.text: Negate the effect of a Monster Card that targets this 1 card.

cards.name: Magical Marionette
cards.text: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. This card gains 200 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 2 Spell Counters from this card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

cards.name: Pixie Knight
cards.text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, your opponent selects 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard, and places that card on the top of your Deck.

cards.name: Breaker the Magical Warrior
cards.text: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Spell Counter on it (max. 1). Gains 300 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

cards.name: Magical Plant Mandragola
cards.text: FLIP: Place 1 Spell Counter on each face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on.

cards.name: Magical Scientist
cards.text: Pay 1000 Life Points to Special Summon 1 level 6 or lower Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck in face-up Attack or Defense Position. That Fusion Monster cannot attack your opponent's Life Points directly, and is returned to your Extra Deck at the end of the turn.

cards.name: Royal Magical Library
cards.text: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell resolves (max. 3). You can remove 3 Spell Counters from this card; draw 1 card.

cards.name: Armor Exe
cards.text: This card cannot attack in the same turn it is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned. During each of your and your opponent's Standby Phases, remove 1 Spell Counter on your side of the field. If you do not, destroy this card.

cards.name: Tribe-Infecting Virus
cards.text: Discard 1 card from your hand and declare 1 Type of monster. Destroy all face-up monsters of the declared Type on the field.

cards.name: Des Koala
cards.text: FLIP: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand.

cards.name: Dark Scorpion - Cliff the Trap Remover
cards.text:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.
● Send the top 2 cards of their Deck to the Graveyard.

cards.name: Magical Merchant
cards.text: FLIP: Excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a Spell/Trap, then add that card to your hand, also send the remaining cards to the GY.

cards.name: Koitsu
cards.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field, you can equip it to your "Aitsu" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, increase the ATK of the equipped monster by 3000 points. When it attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

cards.name: Cat's Ear Tribe
cards.text: The original ATK of your opponent's monster(s) that battles with this card during his/her turn becomes 200 points during the Damage Step.

cards.name: Ultimate Obedient Fiend
cards.text: This card can only attack if this card is the only card on your side of the field and if you also have no cards in your hand. The effects of Effect Monsters that this card destroys are negated.

cards.name: Dark Cat with White Tail
cards.text: FLIP: Return 2 Monster Cards on your opponent's side of the field and 1 Monster Card on your side of the field to their owners' hands.

cards.name: Amazoness Spellcaster
cards.text: Target 1 "Amazoness" monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; switch the original ATK of those targets until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Continuous Destruction Punch
cards.text: If the DEF of the attacked Defense Position monster on your side of the field is higher than the ATK of the attacking monster on your opponent's side of the field, destroy the attacking monster. Damage calculation is applied normally.

cards.name: Big Bang Shot
cards.text: The equipped monster gains 400 ATK. If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. When this card leaves the field, banish the equipped monster.

cards.name: Gather Your Mind
cards.text: Add 1 "Gather Your Mind" card from your Deck to your hand. Your Deck is then shuffled. You can only use 1 "Gather Your Mind" per turn.

cards.name: Mass Driver
cards.text: Tribute 1 monster on your side of the field to inflict 400 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

cards.name: Senri Eye
cards.text: Once per turn, during each of your Standby Phases, you can pay 100 Life Points to look at 1 card on the top of your opponent's Deck and return it to its original position. Your opponent cannot look at the card.

cards.name: Emblem of Dragon Destroyer
cards.text: Add 1 "Buster Blader" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Jar Robber
cards.text: You can only activate this card when "Pot of Greed" is activated. Negate the effect of the "Pot of Greed" and draw 1 card from your Deck.

cards.name: My Body as a Shield
cards.text: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect that would destroy a monster(s) on the field: Pay 1500 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

cards.name: Spellbook Organization
cards.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your Deck, then return them to the top of the Deck in any order.

cards.name: Mega Ton Magical Cannon
cards.text: Remove 10 Spell Counters on your side of the field. Destroy all cards on your opponent's side of the field.

cards.name: Pitch-Black Power Stone
cards.text: Activate this card by placing 3 Spell Counters on it. Once per turn, during your turn: You can target 1 other face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on; remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, and if you do, place 1 Spell Counter on that target. When the last Spell Counter(s) is removed from this card, destroy it.

cards.name: Amazoness Archers
cards.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack, while you control an "Amazoness" monster: Change all monsters your opponent currently controls to face-up Attack Position (Flip Effects are not activated), they lose 500 ATK, also they must attack this turn, if able.

cards.name: Dramatic Rescue
cards.text: Activate only when a card is activated that targets an "Amazoness" monster. Return the targeted monster to its owner's hand and Special Summon 1 other monster from your hand.

cards.name: Exhausting Spell
cards.text: Remove all Spell Counters on both sides of the field.

cards.name: Hidden Spellbook
cards.text: During your turn: Target 2 Spell Cards in your Graveyard; shuffle those targets into the Deck.

cards.name: Miracle Restoring
cards.text: Remove 2 Spell Counters from your side of the field, then target 1 "Dark Magician" or "Buster Blader" in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

cards.name: Remove Brainwashing
cards.text: The control of all monsters on the field returns to the owners.

cards.name: Disarmament
cards.text: Destroy all Equip Cards on the field.

cards.name: Anti-Spell
cards.text: Remove 2 Spell Counters on your side of the field to negate the activation of a Spell Card and destroy it.

cards.name: The Spell Absorbing Life
cards.text: Flip all face-down Defense Position Monster Cards on the field face-up. Flip Effects are not activated at this time. Increase your Life Points by 400 points for each Effect Monster Card on the field.

cards.name: Dark Paladin
cards.text:
"Dark Magician" + "Buster Blader"
Must be Fusion Summoned. When a Spell Card is activated (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect. Gains 500 ATK for each Dragon monster on the field and in the GY.

cards.name: Double Spell
cards.text: Discard 1 Spell Card, then target 1 Spell Card in your opponent's Graveyard; place that target in the appropriate Zone on your side of the field, and as this card's effect resolution, follow its card text as if you had used it yourself.

cards.name: Diffusion Wave-Motion
cards.text:
(This card is not treated as a "Fusion" card.)
If your opponent controls a monster: Pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Level 7 or higher Spellcaster monster you control; this turn, it must attack all monsters your opponent controls once each, also other monsters you control cannot attack. The effects of monsters destroyed by these attacks cannot activate and are negated.

cards.name: Vampire Lord
cards.text: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent sends 1 card of that type from their Deck to the GY. Once per turn, during your next Standby Phase after this card in your possession was destroyed and sent to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card from the GY.

cards.name: Battle Footballer
cards.text: A cyborg with high defense power. Originally it was invented for a football machine.

cards.name: Nin-Ken Dog
cards.text: A Ninja dog who has mastered extreme Ninjutsu. Through hard training, it learned the technique to metamorphose into a human being.

cards.name: Acrobat Monkey
cards.text: An autonomous monkey type robot which was developed with cutting-edge technology. It moves very acrobatically.

cards.name: Arsenal Summoner
cards.text: FLIP: Add 1 "Guardian" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Celtic Guardian", "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1", "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #2", "Guardian of the Labyrinth", or "The Reliable Guardian".

cards.name: Guardian Elma
cards.text: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Butterfly Dagger - Elma". When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 appropriate Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; equip that target to this card.

cards.name: Guardian Ceal
cards.text: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Shooting Star Bow - Ceal". You can send 1 Equip Spell Card you control that is equipped to this card to the Graveyard to target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

cards.name: Guardian Grarl
cards.text: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Gravity Axe - Grarl". If this is the only card in your hand, you can Special Summon it (from your hand).

cards.name: Guardian Baou
cards.text: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Wicked-Breaking Flamberge - Baou". When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: It gains 1000 ATK. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with this card.

cards.name: Guardian Kay'est
cards.text: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Rod of Silence - Kay'est". This card is unaffected by Spell effects and cannot be targeted for attacks, but does not prevent your opponent from attacking you directly.

cards.name: Guardian Tryce
cards.text: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Twin Swords of Flashing Light - Tryce". When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon the monster from the Graveyard that was used for its Tribute Summon.

cards.name: Cyber Raider
cards.text:
If this card is Summoned: Activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 Equip Card on the field; destroy that target.
● Target 1 Equip Card on the field; equip that target to this card.

cards.name: Reflect Bounder
cards.text: Before damage calculation, if this card is being attacked by an opponent's monster, and was in face-up Attack Position at the start of the Damage Step: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the attacking monster's ATK. If you do, after damage calculation: Destroy this card.

cards.name: Little-Winguard
cards.text: Once per turn, during your End Phase: You can change the battle position of this card.

cards.name: Des Feral Imp
cards.text: FLIP: Target 1 card in your Graveyard; shuffle that target into the Deck.

cards.name: Different Dimension Dragon
cards.text: This card cannot be destroyed by Spell/Trap effects that do not target it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has 1900 or less ATK.

cards.name: Shinato, King of a Higher Plane
cards.text: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Shinato's Ark". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or more from the field or your hand. When this card destroys a Defense Position monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster.

cards.name: Dark Flare Knight
cards.text:
"Dark Magician" + "Flame Swordsman"
You take no Battle Damage from battles involving this card. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 "Mirage Knight" from your hand or Deck.

cards.name: Mirage Knight
cards.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Dark Flare Knight" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During damage calculation only, this card gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling. During the End Phase of a turn this card attacked or was attacked: Banish this card.

cards.name: Berserk Dragon
cards.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "A Deal with Dark Ruler" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each. During each of your End Phases, this card loses 500 ATK.

cards.name: Exodia Necross
cards.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Contract with Exodia", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Cannot be destroyed by battle or Spell/Trap effect. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: This card gains 500 ATK. Destroy this card unless all 5 of these cards are in your Graveyard - "Exodia the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One", "Left Arm of the Forbidden One", "Right Leg of the Forbidden One" and "Left Leg of the Forbidden One".

cards.name: Gyaku-Gire Panda
cards.text: Increase the ATK of this card by 500 points for each monster on your opponent's side of the field. When this card attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

cards.name: Blindly Loyal Goblin
cards.text: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, control of this card cannot switch.

cards.name: Despair from the Dark
cards.text: If this card is sent from your hand or Deck to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card.

cards.name: Maju Garzett
cards.text: The ATK of this card becomes equal to the combined original ATK of the 2 monsters you Tributed for the Tribute Summon of this card.

cards.name: Fear from the Dark
cards.text: When this card is sent from your hand or Deck to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card.

cards.name: Dark Scorpion - Chick the Yellow
cards.text:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Target 1 card on the field; return that target to the hand.
● Look at the top card of their Deck, then return it to the top or bottom of the Deck.

cards.name: D.D. Warrior Lady
cards.text: After damage calculation, when this card battles an opponent's monster: You can banish that monster, also banish this card.

cards.name: Thousand Needles
cards.text: When this Defense Position card is attacked and if the DEF of this card is higher than the ATK of the attacking monster, destroy the attacking monster at the end of the Damage Step.

cards.name: Shinato's Ark
cards.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or more from the field or your hand.

cards.name: A Deal with Dark Ruler
cards.text:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
If a Level 8 or higher monster under your control was sent to the Graveyard this turn: Special Summon 1 "Berserk Dragon" from your hand or Deck.

cards.name: Contract with Exodia
cards.text: If you have all 5 of "Exodia the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One", "Left Arm of the Forbidden One", "Right Leg of the Forbidden One", and "Left Leg of the Forbidden One" in your Graveyard: Special Summon 1 "Exodia Necross" from your hand.

cards.name: Butterfly Dagger - Elma
cards.text: The equipped monster gains 300 ATK. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard while equipped: You can return this card to the hand.

cards.name: Shooting Star Bow - Ceal
cards.text: The equipped monster loses 1000 ATK, but it can attack your opponent directly.

cards.name: Gravity Axe - Grarl
cards.text: The equipped monster gains 500 ATK. Monsters your opponent controls cannot change their battle positions.

cards.name: Wicked-Breaking Flamberge - Baou
cards.text: Send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 monster on the field; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. Negate the effects of opponent's monsters destroyed by battle with the equipped monster.

cards.name: Rod of Silence - Kay'est
cards.text: The equipped monster gains 500 DEF. Negate other Spell effects that target the equipped monster, and if you do, destroy that Spell Card.

cards.name: Twin Swords of Flashing Light - Tryce
cards.text: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard; equip this card to a monster. It loses 500 ATK, but it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

cards.name: Precious Cards from Beyond
cards.text: When you Tribute Summon a monster using 2 or more Tributes: Draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Rod of the Mind's Eye
cards.text: If a monster equipped with this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, the damage becomes 1000 points.

cards.name: Fairy of the Spring
cards.text: Target 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand. That Equip Spell Card cannot be activated this turn.

cards.name: Token Thanksgiving
cards.text: Destroy all tokens on the field. Increase your Life Points by the number of tokens destroyed x 800 points.

cards.name: Morale Boost
cards.text: Each time a player equips an Equip Spell Card, increase the Life Points of the controller of that Equip Spell Card by 1000 points. Each time an Equip Spell Card is removed from the field, the controller of that Equip Spell Card takes 1000 points of damage.

cards.name: Non-Spellcasting Area
cards.text: All face-up monsters, except for Effect Monsters, are unaffected by other Spell effects.

cards.name: Different Dimension Gate
cards.text: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster on each side of the field; banish those targets. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Return those banished monsters to the field in the same battle positions they were in.

cards.name: Final Attack Orders
cards.text: All face-up monsters on the field are changed to Attack Position and their battle positions cannot be changed.

cards.name: Staunch Defender
cards.text: You can only activate this card when your opponent declares an attack. Select 1 face-up monster on your side of the field. During this turn, your opponent can only designate the selected monster as an attack target and your opponent must attack the selected monster with all face-up monsters.

cards.name: Ojama Trio
cards.text: Special Summon 3 "Ojama Tokens" (Beast-Type/LIGHT/Level 2/ATK 0/DEF 1000) to your opponent's field in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon, and each time 1 is destroyed, its controller takes 300 damage.

cards.name: Arsenal Robber
cards.text: Your opponent selects 1 Equip Spell Card from his/her Deck and sends it to the Graveyard.

cards.name: Skill Drain
cards.text: Activate by paying 1000 LP. Negate the effects of all face-up monsters while they are face-up on the field (but their effects can still be activated).

cards.name: Really Eternal Rest
cards.text: Destroy all monsters equipped with an Equip Card(s).

cards.name: Kaiser Glider
cards.text: Cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has the same ATK. If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 monster on the field; return that target to the hand.

cards.name: Interdimensional Matter Transporter
cards.text: Target 1 face-up monster you control; banish that target until the End Phase.

cards.name: Cost Down
cards.text: Discard 1 card; for the rest of this turn, reduce the Levels of all monsters in your hand by 2 (even after they are Summoned).

cards.name: Gagagigo
cards.text: This young evildoer used to have an evil heart, but by meeting a special person, he discovered justice.

cards.name: D.D. Trainer
cards.text: A poor goblin that was sucked into a different dimension. However, he's doing his best with his new destiny.

cards.name: Ojama Green
cards.text: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

cards.name: Archfiend Soldier
cards.text: An expert at battle who belongs to a crack diabolical unit. He's famous because he always gets the job done.

cards.name: Pandemonium Watchbear
cards.text: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, "Pandemonium" on your side of the field is not destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

cards.name: Sasuke Samurai #2
cards.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can pay 800 Life Points. If you do this, until the End Phase, Spell and Trap Cards cannot be activated.

cards.name: Dark Scorpion - Gorg the Strong
cards.text:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the top of the Deck.
● Send the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard.

cards.name: Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn
cards.text:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
● Add 1 "Dark Scorpion" card from your Deck to your hand.
● Target 1 "Dark Scorpion" card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

cards.name: Outstanding Dog Marron
cards.text: When this card is sent to your Graveyard, add it to your Deck and shuffle it.

cards.name: Great Maju Garzett
cards.text: The ATK of this card becomes twice the original ATK of 1 monster that you Tributed for the Tribute Summon of this card.

cards.name: Iron Blacksmith Kotetsu
cards.text: FLIP: Add 1 Equip Spell from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Goblin of Greed
cards.text: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, neither player can activate an effect by discarding from his/her hand.

cards.name: Mefist the Infernal General
cards.text: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Make your opponent discard 1 random card.

cards.name: Vilepawn Archfiend
cards.text: The controller of this card pays 500 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When this card is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 3, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card. As long as this card remains on the field, your opponent cannot attack any Archfiend Monster Card on your side of the field except "Vilepawn Archfiend".

cards.name: Shadowknight Archfiend
cards.text: The controller of this card pays 900 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When this card is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 3, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card. The Battle Damage this card inflicts to your opponent is halved.

cards.name: Darkbishop Archfiend
cards.text: The controller of this card pays 500 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When an Archfiend Monster Card on your side of the field is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 1, 3, or 6, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card.

cards.name: Desrook Archfiend
cards.text: The controller of this card pays 500 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When this card is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 3, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card. When a "Terrorking Archfiend" on your side of the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard to Special Summon the "Terrorking Archfiend".

cards.name: Infernalqueen Archfiend
cards.text: The controller of this card pays 500 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When this card is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 2 or 5, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card. As long as this card remains on the field, during each Standby Phase, increase the ATK of 1 Archfiend Monster Card by 1000 points until the End Phase.

cards.name: Terrorking Archfiend
cards.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned unless you have an Archfiend Monster Card on your side of the field. The controller of this card pays 800 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When this card is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 2 or 5, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card. The effects of an Effect Monster that this card destroyed as a result of battle are negated.

cards.name: Skull Archfiend of Lightning
cards.text: During each of your Standby Phases, you must pay 500 Life Points (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. Before resolving an opponent's card effect that targets this card, roll a six-sided die, negate the effect if you roll 1, 3, or 6, and if you do, destroy that card.

cards.name: Metallizing Parasite - Lunatite
cards.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to a face-up monster on your side of the field as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, that monster will be unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards controlled by your opponent. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the monster that this card is equipped to is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

cards.name: Tsukuyomi
cards.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Normal Summoned or flipped face-up this turn: Return it to the hand.

cards.name: Mudora
cards.text: This card gains 200 ATK for each Fairy-Type monster in your Graveyard.

cards.name: Keldo
cards.text: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, select 2 cards from your opponent's Graveyard, add them to your opponent's Deck and the Deck is then shuffled.

cards.name: Kelbek
cards.text: A monster that attacks this card returns to the hand. Damage calculation is applied normally.

cards.name: Zolga
cards.text: When a monster is Tribute Summoned by Tributing this card: The owner of this card gains 2000 Life Points.

cards.name: Agido
cards.text: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, roll a six-sided die. You can Special Summon 1 Fairy-Type monster from your Graveyard whose Level is equal to the number rolled. (If the result is 6, you can Special Summon a Level 6 or higher monster.)

cards.name: Legendary Flame Lord
cards.text: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Incandescent Ordeal". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 7 or more from the field or your hand. Each time you or your opponent activates 1 Spell Card, put 1 Spell Counter on this card. Remove 3 Spell Counters from this card to destroy all monsters on the field except this card.

cards.name: Dark Master - Zorc
cards.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Contract with the Dark Master". Once per turn: You can roll a six-sided die, then destroy all monsters your opponent controls if you roll 1 or 2, destroy 1 monster your opponent controls if you roll 3, 4 or 5, or destroy all monsters you control if you roll 6.

cards.name: Spell Reproduction
cards.text: Send 2 Spells from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand.

cards.name: Dragged Down into the Grave
cards.text: Both players reveal their hands, each chooses 1 card from their opponent's hand, then you discard the chosen cards from both players' hands, then both players draw 1 card.

cards.name: Incandescent Ordeal
cards.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Legendary Flame Lord". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 7 or more from the field or your hand.

cards.name: Contract with the Abyss
cards.text: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any DARK Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

cards.name: Contract with the Dark Master
cards.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Dark Master - Zorc". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

cards.name: Falling Down
cards.text: Activate this card by targeting an opponent's monster; equip this card to it. Take control of it. Destroy this card unless you control an "Archfiend" card. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases: You take 800 damage.

cards.name: Checkmate
cards.text: Tribute 1 Archfiend monster on your side of the field. During this turn, 1 "Terrorking Archfiend" on your side of the field can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

cards.name: Cestus of Dagla
cards.text: Equip only to a Fairy-Type monster. It gains 500 ATK. If it inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Gain LP equal to the damage inflicted.

cards.name: Final Countdown
cards.text: Pay 2000 Life Points. After 20 turns have passed (counting the turn you activate this card as the 1st turn), you win the Duel.

cards.name: Archfiend's Oath
cards.text: Once per turn: You can pay 500 Life Points, then declare 1 card name; excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is the declared card, add it to your hand. Otherwise, send it to the Graveyard.

cards.name: Mustering of the Dark Scorpions
cards.text: If you control a face-up "Don Zaloog": You can Special Summon any number of "Dark Scorpion" monsters from your hand, but only 1 copy of each.

cards.name: Pandemonium
cards.text: Neither player has to pay Life Points during the Standby Phase for "Archfiend" monsters. Each time a player's "Archfiend" monster(s) is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, except by battle, that player can add 1 "Archfiend" monster from their Deck to their hand that is a lower Level than the destroyed card.

cards.name: Altar for Tribute
cards.text: Select 1 monster on your side of the field and send it to the Graveyard. Increase your Life Points by an amount equal to the original ATK of the monster.

cards.name: Frozen Soul
cards.text: You can only activate this card when your Life Points are at least 2000 lower than your opponent's. Skip your opponent's next Battle Phase.

cards.name: Battle-Scarred
cards.text: Select 1 Archfiend monster on your side of the field to activate this card. Your opponent also pays the same Life Points that you pay for the selected monster during the Standby Phase. If this card is removed from the field, destroy the selected monster. When the selected monster is removed from the field, destroy this card.

cards.name: Dark Scorpion Combination
cards.text: You can only activate this card when there are "Don Zaloog", "Cliff the Trap Remover", "Dark Scorpion - Chick the Yellow", "Dark Scorpion - Gorg the Strong", and "Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn" face-up on your side of the field. During this turn, any of these 5 cards can attack your opponent's Life Points directly. In that case, the Battle Damage inflicted to your opponent by each of those cards becomes 400 points.

cards.name: Archfiend's Roar
cards.text: Pay 500 Life Points, then target 1 "Archfiend" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. It cannot be Tributed. Destroy it during the End Phase of this turn.

cards.name: Dice Re-Roll
cards.text: One time, during the rest of this turn, if either player(s) rolls a die (or dice), you can have the player(s) re-roll. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.)

cards.name: Spell Vanishing
cards.text: Discard 2 cards from your hand. Negate the activation of a Spell Card and destroy it. Also, look at your opponent's hand and Deck and if you find any Spell Cards of the same name as the destroyed Spell Card, send all of them to the Graveyard.

cards.name: Sakuretsu Armor
cards.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; destroy that target.

cards.name: Ray of Hope
cards.text: Add 2 LIGHT monsters from your Graveyard to your Deck and shuffle it.

cards.name: Blast Held by a Tribute
cards.text: When an opponent's monster that was Tribute Summoned declares an attack: Destroy as many face-up Attack Position monsters they control as possible, and if you do, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

cards.name: Judgment of Anubis
cards.text: When your opponent activates a Spell Card that would destroy a Spell/Trap Card(s) on the field: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, then you can destroy 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, and if you do that, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the destroyed monster's ATK on the field.

cards.name: Ancient Tool
cards.text: A destructive machine discovered in the Ruins of the Ancients.

cards.name: Rhaimundos of the Red Sword
cards.text: Armed with the Sword of Crimson Flames, this warrior can bind a monster with fiery restraints.

cards.name: Aqua Snake
cards.text: ''This monster hypnotizes an opponent with the ball on its tail and draws them to a watery doom.''

cards.name: Aqua Dragon
cards.text: "Fairy Dragon" + "Amazon of the Seas" + "Zone Eater"

cards.name: Aqua Chorus
cards.text: If there are monsters with the same name on the field, increase the ATK and DEF of all of those monsters with the same name by 500 points.

cards.name: Beastly Mirror Ritual
cards.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Fiend's Mirror". You must also Tribute monsters from the field or your hand whose total Levels equal 6 or more.

cards.name: Skull Dice
cards.text: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK/DEF equal to the result x 100, until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Exile of the Wicked
cards.text: Destroy all Fiend monsters on the field.

cards.name: Nightmare's Steelcage
cards.text: This card remains on the field for 2 of your opponent's turns. While this card is face-up on the field, no monsters can attack.

cards.name: Acid Crawler
cards.text: ''A giant caterpillar that secretes an acid mist that melts anything.''

cards.name: Axe Raider
cards.text: An axe-wielding monster of tremendous strength and agility.

cards.name: Fiend Reflection #1
cards.text: This monster can draw its enemies into a mirror world that renders them helpless.

cards.name: Arlownay
cards.text: ''A lady monster dwelling in a flower, she sprinkles the air with poisonous pollen.''

cards.name: Archfiend of Gilfer
cards.text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip that target with this card. That monster loses 500 ATK while equipped with this card.

cards.name: Zombie Warrior
cards.text: "Skull Servant" + "Battle Warrior"

cards.name: Arma Knight
cards.text: ''An ammonite warrior that has protected the seas throughout history.''

cards.name: The Statue of Easter Island
cards.text: A stone monument from Easter Island that launches laser blasts from its rock-hewn lips.

cards.name: Swordsman from a Distant Land
cards.text: If this card attacked an opponent's monster, after damage calculation: Destroy that monster during the 5th End Phase after the attack.

cards.name: Invader from Another Dimension
cards.text: An extraterrestrial monster that came from a distant galaxy.

cards.name: D.D. Warrior
cards.text: After damage calculation, when this card battles a monster: Banish that monster, also banish this card.

cards.name: Fairy of the Fountain
cards.text: ''This fairy protects a fountain from any who seek to muddy its waters.''

cards.name: Windstorm of Etaqua
cards.text: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

cards.name: Living Vase
cards.text: ''A living vase that bites enemies and blinds them with a blast of pollen from its flower.''

cards.name: Hourglass of Life
cards.text: This creature grants power instead of shortening life.

cards.name: That Which Feeds on Life
cards.text: A monster that feeds on the energy of other creatures.

cards.name: Obese Marmot of Nefariousness
