cards.text:
(This card is always treated as a "Darklord" card.)
Send 1 Fairy monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Darklord" monster from your hand, Deck, or banishment, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only activate 1 "Fallen Angel in Darkness" per turn.

cards.name: Junk Armor
cards.text: Your opponent cannot target Synchro Monsters you control with "Warrior" or "Stardust" in their original names, with card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Junk Armor" once per turn. If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon it. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Junk" or "Synchron" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Junk Armor".

cards.name: Junk Meister
cards.text: You can reveal 1 "Warrior" or "Stardust" Synchro Monster in your Extra Deck; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Monsters. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Junk" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Junk Meister". You can target 1 "Junk" monster you control; reduce its Level by up to 2. You can only use each effect of "Junk Meister" once per turn.

cards.name: Over Tuning
cards.text: If you control a Tuner: Special Summon 1 Tuner from your hand, Deck, or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except Synchro Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Over Tuning" per turn.

cards.name: Champion's Pulse
cards.text:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● During your opponent's Battle Phase: Your opponent gains 1000 LP, then end the Battle Phase.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect while they control more cards than you do: Special Summon 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" or "Hot Red Dragon Archfiend" from your Extra Deck or GY, and if you do, negate that activated effect, and if you do that, destroy that monster.
You can only activate 1 "Champion's Pulse" per turn.

cards.name: Surprise Fusion
cards.text: Target 1 face-up monster you control and declare 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute; that monster becomes that Type and Attribute, then you can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters you control, including the targeted monster. You can banish this card from your GY; Tribute 1 Fusion Monster, and if you do, Special Summon 2 "Surprise Tokens" (Spellcaster/DARK/ATK 0/DEF 0) with a Level equal to the Level the Tributed monster had on the field. You can only use this effect of "Surprise Fusion" once per turn.

cards.name: Endymion Empire
cards.text: When this card is activated: Add 1 "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" or 1 monster that mentions it from your Deck to your hand, then if your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon 1 Spellcaster monster from your hand. If a card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" in your hand or face-up Monster Zone instead. You can only use this effect of "Endymion Empire" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Endymion Empire" per turn.

cards.name: Regulus, the Prince of Endymion
cards.text: The first time this card would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed. You can only use each of the following effects of "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 other Spellcaster monster in your hand; you lose LP equal to the revealed monster's Level x 300, and if you do, Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 Spell that mentions "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Theorealize
cards.text: Send 1 "Medius the Pure" from your Deck to the GY; look at the top card of your opponent's Deck, and place it on the top or bottom of the Deck. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster you control and declare 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute; that monster becomes that Type and Attribute, until the end of your opponent's turn. You can only use each effect of "Theorealize" once per turn.

cards.name: Unbreakable Xyz Barrier
cards.text: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control an Xyz Monster: Negate the activation, then you can detach 2 materials from a monster(s) you control, then destroy 1 card on the field. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Xyz Monster you control; attach 1 LIGHT "Utopia" or "Utopic" Xyz Monster from your GY to it. You can only use each effect of "Unbreakable Xyz Barrier" once per turn.

cards.name: The Fallen & The Virtuous
cards.text:
(This card is always treated as a "Branded" and "Dogmatika" card.)
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Send 1 monster that mentions "Fallen of Albaz" from your Extra Deck to the GY, then target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy it.
● If you have an "Ecclesia" monster in your field or GY: Target 1 monster in either GY; Special Summon it to your field.
You can only activate 1 "The Fallen & The Virtuous" per turn.

cards.name: Black Chaos
cards.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by shuffling 1 Spellcaster or Warrior Ritual Monster from your hand or GY into the Deck. You can only Special Summon "Black Chaos" once per turn this way. You can discard this card; place 1 Continuous Trap that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your Deck or GY, face-up on your field. While you have a Ritual Spell in your GY, this card is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can banish 2 cards your opponent controls.

cards.name: Skull Archfiend of Chaos
cards.text: If this card is in your hand or GY: You can target 3 other cards in the GYs and/or face-up banishment, including a card that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual"; place them on the bottom of the Deck in any order, and if you do, Special Summon this card. If this card is sent to the GY: You can send 1 Ritual Spell from your hand or Deck to the GY; add 1 Ritual Monster whose name is mentioned on that card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Skull Archfiend of Chaos" once per turn.

cards.name: Celtic Mystic
cards.text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can reveal your entire hand, and if you revealed a card that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual", you can draw 3 cards, then discard 2 cards, also for the rest of this turn, you can only Special Summon once from the Extra Deck. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Ritual Monster that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your hand. You can only use each effect of "Celtic Mystic" once per turn.

cards.name: Griffoh
cards.text:
(Quick Effect): You can discard this card, then activate 1 of these effects;
● The next battle or effect damage you take this turn will become 0.
● Set 1 Quick-Play Spell or Trap that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your Deck. It can be activated this turn.
You can only use this effect of "Griffoh" once per turn. If you Ritual Summon exactly 1 Level 8 Ritual Monster with a card effect that requires use of monsters, this card can be used as the entire Tribute.

cards.name: Inferno of the Sacred Beasts - Uria, Lord of Searing Flames
cards.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with the effect of a "Sacred Beast" card. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Sacred Beast" Trap from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Inferno of the Sacred Beasts - Uria, Lord of Searing Flames" once per turn. Gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each Trap in the GYs. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation.

cards.name: Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
cards.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with the effect of a "Sacred Beast" card. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Sacred Beast" Spell from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder" once per turn. Once per turn, if a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can activate this effect; you take no damage this turn.

cards.name: Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms
cards.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with the effect of a "Sacred Beast" card. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Sacred Beast" monster from your Deck to your hand except "Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms", then discard 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms" once per turn. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 2 other "Sacred Beast" monsters; destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, this card gains 1000 ATK for each card destroyed.

cards.name: Summoner of the Sacred Beasts
cards.text: You can reveal this card in your hand; discard 1 card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Sacred Beast" monster from your hand in Defense Position, except a Level 8 monster. You can discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 "Sacred Beast" monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position, except a Level 8 monster or the discarded card. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Sacred Beast" monster from your GY in Defense Position, except a Level 8 monster. You can only use each effect of "Summoner of the Sacred Beasts" once per turn.

cards.name: Martyr of the Sacred Beasts
cards.text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can place 1 "Sacred Beast" Field Spell or 1 "Sacred Beast" Continuous Spell/Trap from your Deck, face-up on your field. If you control another "Sacred Beast" monster: You can Special Summon 2 "Martyr of the Sacred Beasts" from your hand, Deck, and/or GY. During your opponent's End Phase, if you have this card and a Level 10 "Sacred Beast" monster in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Martyr of the Sacred Beasts" once per turn.

cards.name: Whisker Blitzclique
cards.text: During the turn a card(s) was destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card effect (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon up to 3 Thunder monsters from your hand, then you can destroy up to that many cards on the field, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. When a monster effect is activated, except in the hand (Quick Effect): You can return 1 other Thunder monster you control to the hand; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster. You can only use each effect of "Whisker Blitzclique" once per turn.

cards.name: Surge Blitzclique
cards.text: You can reveal this card in your hand, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If another card(s) is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Blitzclique" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Surge Blitzclique". You can only use each effect of "Surge Blitzclique" once per turn.

cards.name: Crackle Blitzclique
cards.text: During your opponent's turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; destroy that monster, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If another card(s) is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can send 1 "Blitzclique" Spell/Trap from your Deck to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Crackle Blitzclique" once per turn.

cards.name: Grain Blitzclique
cards.text: You can reveal this card in your hand, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If another card(s) is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Blitzclique" Spell or 1 "Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Grain Blitzclique" once per turn.

cards.name: Emi Blitzclique
cards.text: If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can reveal this card, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If another card(s) is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Blitzclique" Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Emi Blitzclique" once per turn.

cards.name: Aleister the Reminiscent
cards.text: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 Spellcaster monster or 1 Fusion Monster on the field; Special Summon this card, and if you do, the targeted monster gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or flipped face-up: You can banish 1 "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck; add 1 "Invocation", or 1 Spell that mentions it, from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Aleister the Reminiscent" once per turn.

cards.name: Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law
cards.text: You can banish this card from your hand or field; add 1 "Aleister" monster from your Deck to your hand, then if this effect was activated on the field, immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon 1 Spellcaster monster. If a face-up Fusion Monster(s) you control is sent to the GY, except by battle, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card, then you can Fusion Summon 1 "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law" once per turn.

cards.name: Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice
cards.text: If you have an "Aleister" monster in your field or GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Invocation", or 1 Spell that mentions it, from your Deck. When your opponent activates a card or effect in response to your Fusion Monster's effect activation (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control, and if you do, negate that opponent's effect, and if you do that, banish it. You can only use each effect of "Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice" once per turn.

cards.name: The Phantom Knights of Decayed Cloak
cards.text: If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 other "The Phantom Knights" card in your hand; Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "The Phantom Knights" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Xyz Monster you control; this turn, you can use that face-up Xyz Monster as material for an Xyz Summon using its Rank as if it were a Level. You can only use each effect of "The Phantom Knights of Decayed Cloak" once per turn.

cards.name: The Phantom Knights of Doomed Soleret
cards.text: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "The Phantom Knights of Doomed Soleret" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "The Phantom Knights of Doomed Soleret" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "The Phantom Knights" Spell/Trap from your Deck. You can banish this card from your GY, then target up to 2 Level/Rank 3 DARK monsters you control; increase their Levels/Ranks by 1.

cards.name: S-Force Signify
cards.text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "S-Force" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "S-Force Signify", then if your opponent controls a monster in this card's column, you can draw 1 card. If your opponent activates a monster effect in the same column as a monster you control (except during the Damage Step): You can make all "S-Force" monsters you control gain 1000 ATK. You can only use each effect of "S-Force Signify" once per turn.

cards.name: Melffy Rabbys
cards.text: If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can Fusion Summon 1 "Melffy" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Melffy" monster from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a Normal Monster, you can Special Summon any number of Beast monsters from your hand. You can only use 1 "Melffy Rabbys" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Phara the Primordial Goddess
cards.text: You can reveal this card and 1 Spell/Trap in your hand; until the end of the next turn, neither player can activate cards or effects in response to the activation of cards, or effects of cards, with the revealed Spell/Trap's name. If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY by a Spell/Trap effect: You can Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can take control of 1 monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied). You can only use each effect of "Phara the Primordial Goddess" once per turn.

cards.name: Astrazma Urania
cards.text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by returning 1 or 2 monsters you control to the hand. You can only Special Summon "Astrazma Urania" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Astrazma Urania" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can reveal any number of monsters in your hand with different Levels, then target that many face-up cards your opponent controls; negate their effects. If this card on the field is destroyed by card effect and sent to the GY: You can add this card to your hand.

cards.name: Sorcerer of the Swamp
cards.text: If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck and banish 1 material whose name is mentioned on it from your Deck, then Special Summon this card, and if you do, this card's name can be treated as the banished monster's, if used as Fusion Material this turn. You can only use this effect of "Sorcerer of the Swamp" once per turn.

cards.name: Twilight Specter Rayrage
cards.text:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
If a Pendulum Monster(s) you control would be destroyed by an opponent's card effect, you can destroy this card instead of 1 of those Pendulum Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Twilight Specter Rayrage" once per turn.

[ Monster Effect ] 
If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 Pendulum Monster you control; place that Pendulum Monster in your Pendulum Zone (neither player can activate its Pendulum Effects this turn), and if you do, Special Summon this card. (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card, then target 1 card in your Pendulum Zone; it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects this turn. You can only use each effect of "Twilight Specter Rayrage" once per turn.

cards.name: Gray Layer
cards.text: You can Tribute this card, then reveal 1 Machine monster in your hand; add 1 Machine monster with a different Attribute from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a monster with 1200 or less ATK, you can Special Summon 1 Machine monster from your hand. If a monster(s) in your possession is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card; destroy 1 card on the field. You can only use each effect of "Gray Layer" once per turn.

cards.name: Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos
cards.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Light and Darkness Ritual". Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects, unless they target this card, also Spells/Traps you control cannot be destroyed, or banished, by your opponent's card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 Spell from your GY to your hand. You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish it face-down.

cards.name: Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness
cards.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Light and Darkness Ritual". Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects, unless they target this card, also cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish it. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can make this card gain 1500 ATK, and if you do, it can make a second attack in a row.

cards.name: The Chaotic Phantasmal Sacred Beasts
cards.text:
3 Level 10 monsters that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set
Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards you control to the GY. You can only Special Summon "The Chaotic Phantasmal Sacred Beasts" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. The first two times this card on the field would be destroyed by card effect each turn, it is not destroyed. Once per Chain, up to thrice per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects (until the end of this turn), then you can gain LP equal to half that monster's ATK.

cards.name: Invoked Sorath
cards.text:
1 "Aleister" monster + 1 FIRE or WIND monster
During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Level 6 or lower monster in either GY; Special Summon it to your field in Defense Position, but negate its effects. If this card is in your GY: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Invoked" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing this card from your GY and monsters from your field or GY as material. You can only use each effect of "Invoked Sorath" once per turn.

cards.name: Invoked Baybarron
cards.text:
1 "Aleister" monster + 1 LIGHT or EARTH monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice" or 1 "Gamma Summon" from your Deck to your hand, then you can banish 1 monster from either GY. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion Monster you control; monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK equal to the targeted monster's ATK, until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Invoked Baybarron" once per turn.

cards.name: Invoked Oceanus
cards.text:
1 "Aleister" monster + 1 DARK or WATER monster
While this card is in the Main Monster Zone, your opponent's monsters cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one. While this card is in the Extra Monster Zone, any monster sent to your opponent's GY is banished instead. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion Monster you control; it can attack directly this turn. You can only use this effect of "Invoked Oceanus" once per turn.

cards.name: Hyperinvoked Aeon
cards.text:
2+ Fusion Monsters with different Attributes
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can banish cards from the field and/or GYs, up to the number of monsters used as material, then if you used 3 or more materials, you can look at your opponent's Extra Deck and banish up to 3 cards from it. (Quick Effect): You can declare 1 Attribute; all other monsters on the field become that Attribute until the end of this turn. You can only use 1 "Hyperinvoked Aeon" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Melffys' Joyful Surprise
cards.text:
1 "Melffy" monster + 1 Beast monster
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can target an equal number of "Melffy" cards you control and cards your opponent controls; return them to the hand. If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step), or if an opponent's monster targets this card for an attack: You can target 1 Beast monster in your GY; reduce this card's Level by exactly 2, and if you do, Special Summon that target. You can only use each effect of "Melffys' Joyful Surprise" once per turn.

cards.name: Elfnote June Pride
cards.text:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner Spellcaster monster
While this card is in the center Main Monster Zone, neither player can declare attacks, except with monsters in their center Main Monster Zones. During the Main Phase, if this card is in the center Main Monster Zone (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon up to 1 "Elfnote" monster each from your hand, Deck, and GY. You can only use this effect of "Elfnote June Pride" once per turn.

cards.name: Glitch Clutch Nullgainer
cards.text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can add 1 Level 8 or higher monster with 0 ATK from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 monster with 0 ATK in your GY; Special Summon it, but negate its effects, also it cannot be used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Summon. You can only use each effect of "Glitch Clutch Nullgainer" once per turn.

cards.name: The Phantom Knights of Malevolent Scythe
cards.text:
2 Level 3 DARK monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 "The Phantom Knights" monster from your Deck. If you Xyz Summon an "Xyz Dragon" monster, while this card is in your Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell from your Deck to your hand. If this card is destroyed: You can add 1 of your banished "The Phantom Knights" cards to your hand, except Xyz Monsters. You can only use each effect of "The Phantom Knights of Malevolent Scythe" once per turn.

cards.name: Melffy Godmommy
cards.text:
3+ Level 2 Beast monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Melffy Godmommy" by using "Melffy Mommy" you control (transfer its materials). If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Melffy" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. Gains ATK equal to the combined ATK and DEF of "Melffy" monsters attached to it. You can detach 5 materials from this card; return all cards your opponent controls to the hand.

cards.name: Purification Power Patron
cards.text:
2 non-Link Monsters
If this card is Link Summoned, and you have a "Power Patron" monster in your GY: You can add 1 "Theorealize" card from your Deck to your hand. During the Main Phase, if you control another DARK Fairy monster, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Link Summon 1 Link Monster using materials you control, including this card. You can only use each effect of "Purification Power Patron" once per turn.

cards.name: S-Force Nightcatcher
cards.text:
2 monsters, including an "S-Force" monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "S-Force" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control and 1 "S-Force" card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "S-Force" monster from your Deck/Extra Deck, except "S-Force Nightcatcher". You can only use each effect of "S-Force Nightcatcher" once per turn.

cards.name: S-Force Mystify
cards.text:
2+ monsters, including an "S-Force" monster
While your opponent controls a monster in this card's column, they cannot target this card with card effects, nor Special Summon by an activated monster effect. (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster on the field; move it to another Main Monster Zone on its controller's field. You can only use this effect of "S-Force Mystify" once per turn.

cards.name: Clown Crew Dristy
cards.text:
2 Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and/or Pendulum Monsters
Your Tribute Summoned monsters can make a second attack during each Battle Phase. If this card is Tributed: You can activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Clown Crew Dristy" once per turn);
● Return all Link Monsters from the field and the GYs to the Extra Deck.
● Each player with a hand shuffles their entire hand into the Deck, then draws the same number of cards they shuffled into the Deck.

cards.name: Zenna's Deceiving Doll Maidens
cards.text:
2+ Effect Monsters
You can also use 1 monster in your hand as material to Link Summon this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Zenna's Deceiving Doll Maidens" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can send 1 monster from your Deck to the GY, or if all materials used for its Link Summon were monsters you controlled, you can send 1 monster from your Extra Deck instead. During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 monster from your GY to your hand.

cards.name: Light and Darkness Ritual
cards.text: This card can be used to Ritual Summon "Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos" or "Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field, and/or banish monsters from your GY, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. If this card is in your GY: You can add this card and 1 card that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Light and Darkness Ritual" once per turn.

cards.name: Chaos Mystic Box
cards.text: When your opponent activates a card or effect that targets another card(s) you control: Return 1 of your targeted cards to the hand (if face-down, reveal it), and if you do, destroy 1 card on the field, then you can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" with a different name than the card returned to the hand, ignoring its Summoning conditions. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 Ritual Monster that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your hand or Deck.

cards.name: Chaos Magical Hats
cards.text: When your opponent activates a monster effect, or a Normal Spell/Trap Card: Choose 3 Spells/Traps with different names from your Deck and 1 monster in your Main Monster Zone that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual". Special Summon the Spells/Traps as Normal Monsters (Spellcaster/DARK/Level 8/ATK 0/DEF 0) in face-down Defense Position (their names become "Chaos Magical Hats" even while face-down), Set the chosen monster if it is face-up, and shuffle them on the field. Then your opponent's activated effect becomes "Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls in face-down Defense Position".

cards.name: Sacred Beasts Released
cards.text: Add 3 "Sacred Beast" monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand, then discard 2 cards. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; add 1 Level 10 Pyro, Thunder, or Fiend monster that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set, from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Sacred Beasts Released" once per turn.

cards.name: Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts
cards.text: Up to thrice per turn, during your Main Phase: You can send 3 other cards of the same type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) from your hand and/or face-up field to the GY, then you can Special Summon 1 "Sacred Beast" monster from your hand, Deck, GY, or banishment, and if you do, it is unaffected by your opponent's activated Spell/Trap effects. If you control a "Sacred Beast" monster whose original Level is 10: You can draw 2 cards. You can only use this effect of "Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts" once per turn.

cards.name: Sacred Beasts Thunderclap
cards.text: During your Main Phase: You can place 2 "Sacred Beasts Thunderclap" from your hand, Deck, and/or GY, face-up on your field, then you can reveal 1 Level 10 "Sacred Beast" monster in your hand, then place 1 "Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts" from your Deck, face-up in your Field Zone. During your opponent's End Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Sacred Beasts Thunderclap" once per turn.

cards.name: Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb
cards.text: Monsters you control that were Normal or Special Summoned from the hand gain 500 ATK/DEF. You can only use each of the following effects of "Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "Mech Beast Token" (Machine/EARTH/Level 6/ATK 2000/DEF 2000) to your opponent's field, and if you do, add 1 "Blitzclique" monster from your Deck to your hand. If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand.

cards.name: Blitzclique - Breakaway
cards.text:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Place 1 "Blitzclique" Continuous Trap from your Deck, face-up on your field.
● Return 1 Thunder monster you control to the hand, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.
If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Blitzclique - Breakaway" once per turn.

cards.name: Blitzclique - Steppleader
cards.text: If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Thunder monster in your GY; add it to your hand. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, then destroy this card. If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Blitzclique - Steppleader" once per turn.

cards.name: Invocation - "Sword"
cards.text: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters you control. If Summoning an "Invoked" Fusion Monster this way, you can also return monsters from any banishment to the GY as material. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can target 1 "Aleister" monster or "Invocation" in your GY; shuffle this card into the Deck, and if you do, add that target to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Invocation - "Sword"" once per turn.

cards.name: Sacred Spirit Sword Aiwass
cards.text:
Activate 1 of these effects, but you cannot declare attacks for the rest of this turn, except with Fusion Monsters;
● Special Summon 1 "Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law" from your Deck or GY.
● Take 1 "Aleister" monster from your Deck, and either send it to the GY or banish it.
● Look at 3 random face-down cards in your opponent's Extra Deck, and if you do, banish 1 of them.
You can only activate 1 "Sacred Spirit Sword Aiwass" per turn.

cards.name: Prohibitive Power Patron Purview - Vilaea
cards.text: Show 1 "Nerva the Power Patron of Creation", 1 "Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction", and 1 "Junora the Power Patron of Tuning" from your Extra Deck, face-up Monster Zone, and/or GY, and if you do, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to the activation of your "Power Patron" monster effects this turn. If you would banish the top card(s) of your Deck to activate the effect of a "Power Patron" monster you control, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Prohibitive Power Patron Purview - Vilaea" once per turn.

cards.name: Theorealize Past Lull
cards.text: If you control an "Artmage", "DoomZ", or "Elfnote" card: You can Special Summon 1 "Medius the Pure" from your hand or Deck. Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when that monster is Special Summoned. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your zone a Link Monster points to. You can only use 1 "Theorealize Past Lull" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: The Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Requiem
cards.text:
Target 1 "The Phantom Knights" or "Xyz Dragon" monster in your GY or banishment; Special Summon it, but negate its effects, then apply the following effect.
● Choose 1 DARK Xyz Monster you control, and Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "The Phantom Knights" or "Xyz Dragon" Xyz Monster that is 1 Rank higher than that monster, by using it as material (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer its materials).
You can only activate 1 "The Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Requiem" per turn.

cards.name: S-Force Origin
cards.text: Special Summon 1 "S-Force" monster from your hand, GY, or banishment, but banish it when it leaves the field. If another card is banished, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card; take 2 "S-Force" cards from your Deck, except "S-Force Origin", banish 1 of them, and send the other to the GY. You can only use each effect of "S-Force Origin" once per turn.

cards.name: Melffy Footsteps
cards.text: Add up to 4 "Melffy" monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand, then it becomes the End Phase of this turn. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 2 "Melffy" cards in your GY, except "Melffy Footsteps"; add 1 of them to your hand, and if you do, place the other on the bottom of your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Melffy Footsteps" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon the turn you activate this card, except "Melffy" monsters.

cards.name: Spiritual Power Recovery Potion
cards.text:
(This card is always treated as a "Possessed" card.)
Banish any number of Spellcaster monsters and/or Spells from your GY; monsters you control gain 200 ATK x the number banished, and if they do, you gain 400 LP x the number banished. During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon any number of Spellcaster monsters with different Attributes from your hand. You can only use 1 "Spiritual Power Recovery Potion" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Pot of Sloth
cards.text: Draw cards equal to the number of cards your opponent controls, then if you drew 2 or more cards, place cards from your hand on the bottom of the Deck in any order, equal to the number you drew -1. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot activate "Pot of Sloth".

cards.name: Ragged Records of Rites
cards.text: Reveal 1 Ritual Spell from your hand or Deck, and if you do, add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand that mentions that Spell's name. If a face-up Ritual Monster(s) you control leaves the field by card effect while this card is in your GY, and you do not control any face-up monsters, other than Ritual Monsters (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Ragged Records of Rites" once per turn.

cards.name: Superconductive Plasma Blast
cards.text:
Activate the following effect depending on whose turn it is;
● Yours: Place 1 Thunder or Rock monster from your Deck on top of your Deck, then if you have a Thunder or Rock monster in your field or GY, you can destroy 1 card on the field.
● Opponent's: Add 1 Thunder or Rock monster from your field, GY or banishment to your hand, or if a monster(s) was destroyed by battle or card effect this turn, you can add 1 such monster from your Deck instead.
You can only activate 1 "Superconductive Plasma Blast" per turn.

cards.name: Summer
cards.text: Once per turn: You can place Season Counters on this card equal to the number of your opponent's unused Main Monster Zones. Once per turn, when your monster declares an attack: You can inflict damage to your opponent equal to the total number of Season Counters on this card and "Spring" in your GY x 400. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can take 1 Field Spell from your hand or Deck that you can place a Season Counter on, and place it face-up on your field (but neither player can activate its effects this turn), and if you do, place all Season Counters on this card on that card.

cards.name: Mind Shuffle
cards.text: During either player's turn: You can add 1 monster that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Mind Shuffle" once per turn. When your opponent activates a card or effect: You can return 1 Level 7 or higher monster you control to the hand; Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your hand, with a different name than the returned monster, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You cannot activate these effects of "Mind Shuffle" in the same Chain.

cards.name: Sacred Beasts Combined Assault
cards.text: Special Summon 1 "Sacred Beast" monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position, then if you control 2 or more "Sacred Beast" monsters whose original Levels are 10, you can negate the effects of 1 face-up card your opponent controls, and if you do, destroy it. You can banish this card from your GY; Fusion Summon 1 "Phantasm" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Sacred Beasts Combined Assault" once per turn.

cards.name: Abyss of the Sacred Beasts
cards.text: You can send 3 face-up "Abyss of the Sacred Beasts" you control to the GY, including this card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change it to face-down Defense Position. You can only use each of the following effects of "Abyss of the Sacred Beasts" once per turn. During the Main Phase: You can place 2 "Abyss of the Sacred Beasts" from your hand, Deck, and/or GY, face-up on your field. During your opponent's End Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can place this card on the bottom of the Deck.

cards.name: Blitzclique Return Stroke
cards.text: "Blitzclique" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Blitzclique Return Stroke" once per turn. When your opponent activates a Spell Card or effect: You can return 1 "Blitzclique" monster you control to the hand; negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Blitzclique" monster in your field or GY; return it to the hand.

cards.name: Blitzclique Alternator
cards.text: Monsters your opponent controls lose 300 ATK/DEF for each Thunder monster you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "Blitzclique Alternator" once per turn. You can shuffle 1 other "Blitzclique" card from your hand or face-up field into the Deck; add 1 Thunder monster with a different name from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Blitzclique" Spell or "Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb" from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Gamma Summon
cards.text: Banish 1 "Aleister" monster or 1 Fusion Monster from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but banish it during the End Phase. If a monster is banished face-up, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 of your banished "Invoked" monsters; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Gamma Summon" once per turn.

cards.name: Power Patron Shade of the Final Hour
cards.text:
Special Summon 1 "Power Patron" monster from your hand, face-up Extra Deck, or GY, then you can apply these effects in sequence, based on the number of different card types (Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz) you control.
● 1+: Banish (face-down) 3 cards from the top of your opponent's Deck.
● 2+: Banish (face-down) 1 card your opponent controls.
● 3: Banish (face-down) 1 random card from your opponent's hand.
You can only activate 1 "Power Patron Shade of the Final Hour" per turn.

cards.name: Elfnotes: Quatrain of Succession
cards.text: The monster in your center Main Monster Zone cannot be banished by your opponent's card effects. You can send 1 other Spell/Trap from your hand or field to the GY, then declare a Level from 1 to 4; Special Summon 1 "Elfnote Seraphim Token" (Plant/Tuner/FIRE/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the declared Level. While that Token is in the Monster Zone, the player who Summoned it cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except "Elfnote" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Elfnotes: Quatrain of Succession" once per turn.

cards.name: The Phantom Knights of Umbrage Veil
cards.text: If you have a "The Phantom Knights" monster in your field or GY, you can activate this card the turn it was Set. Special Summon this card in Defense Position as a Normal Monster (Warrior/DARK/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 300) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then you can change 1 Attack Position monster your opponent controls to Defense Position. You can banish this card from your GY; immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 DARK Xyz Monster. You can only use each effect of "The Phantom Knights of Umbrage Veil" once per turn.

cards.name: S-Force World Sorting
cards.text: If an "S-Force" monster you control would banish a card(s) from your hand to activate its effect, you can send 1 "S-Force" card from your Deck to the GY instead, except "S-Force World Sorting". If another card(s) is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 card in your opponent's field or GY; banish it, then you can move 1 "S-Force" monster you control to another of your Main Monster Zones. You can only use each effect of "S-Force World Sorting" once per turn.

cards.name: Melffy Playtime Surprise
cards.text: Target 1 "Melffy" monster in your field or GY; return it to the hand, then you can Fusion Summon 1 Beast Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. If you control a "Melffy" Xyz Monster: You can banish this card from your GY; for the rest of this turn, "Melffy" monsters you control that are Special Summoned from the Extra Deck are unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. You can only use each effect of "Melffy Playtime Surprise" once per turn.

cards.name: Clown Crew Finale
cards.text: If you control a Tribute Summoned monster: Discard any number of cards, then target that many face-up cards on the field; destroy them. You can banish this card from your GY, and Tribute 1 Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum, or Link Monster from your hand or field; add 1 "Clown Crew" monster with a different original Level/Rank/Link Rating from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Clown Crew Finale" once per turn.

cards.name: Foolish Trap Hole
cards.text: When a monster effect is activated on your opponent's field, during a turn your opponent has Special Summoned: Destroy the monster that activated its effect, then if your opponent controls a card(s) in its adjacent Monster Zones and/or Spell & Trap Zones, destroy them.

cards.name: Lane Restriction
cards.text: When this card is activated: You can Special Summon 1 of your banished monsters to your rightmost Main Monster Zone. If your opponent would Normal or Special Summon a monster(s) in their Main Monster Zone, they must use their leftmost zone(s) that can be used.

cards.name: Annihilate Retroglight
cards.text: When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field, except monsters that were Summoned this turn: Negate that activation, then you can banish (face-down) all face-up monsters your opponent controls, except monsters Summoned this turn. If this Set card in its owner's control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can Set 1 Trap from your Deck.

cards.name: Garden of Talistones
cards.text: While you control 5 cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, any battle damage a player takes is halved, also once per turn, you can activate 1 Continuous Trap Card the turn it was Set. During the Standby Phase: You can reveal 5 Continuous Traps from your Deck with different names, your opponent randomly picks 1 for you to Set, and shuffle the rest into the Deck. You can only use this effect of "Garden of Talistones" once per turn.

cards.name: Witness of the Ancient
cards.text: If you have a Synchro Monster in your field or GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can place up to 3 Synchro Monsters with different names from your Extra Deck and/or GY in your Spell & Trap Zone as face-up Continuous Spells, and Special Summon 1 "Arc Token" (Machine/LIGHT/ATK 0/DEF 0) with a Level equal to the number placed, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. You can only use each effect of "Witness of the Ancient" once per turn.

cards.name: Distrust Paranoia
cards.text:
Take control of all your opponent's monsters in this card's column. If this Set card in its owner's control has left the field by an opponent's effect, and is now in the GY or banished: You can Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Fiend/DARK/Level 10/ATK 4000/DEF 4000) with the following effect (this card is NOT treated as a Trap).
● Unaffected by your opponent's card effects activated in the same column.
You can only activate 1 "Distrust Paranoia" per turn.

cards.name: Yomagna the Fire Phantom
cards.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by shuffling 3 cards of the same type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) from your GY into the Deck/Extra Deck. If this card is Special Summoned: You can declare 1 Monster Type; this card becomes that Type until the end of this turn. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck using monsters on either field, including this card. You can only use each effect of "Yomagna the Fire Phantom" once per turn.

cards.name: Thundercrash Snarecrow
cards.text: Each time a non-Thunder monster(s) is Special Summoned face-up, while this card is in the Monster Zone: That monster(s) cannot attack this turn, also destroy it during the End Phase. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 face-up card you control; destroy it, and if you do, add this card to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Thundercrash Snarecrow" once per turn.

cards.name: Mixousia the Confounder
cards.text:
1 Spellcaster monster + 1 non-Spellcaster monster
You can target 1 face-up monster on the field and declare 1 Attribute; it becomes that Attribute. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing this card you control and monsters from your field or GY as material. If this card is in your GY: You can declare 1 Attribute; this card in the GY becomes that Attribute until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Mixousia the Confounder" once per turn.

cards.name: Shamanite Shamanknight
cards.text:
2+ Level 3 monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned, or if a Trap you own is banished: You can target 1 of your banished Traps; attach it to this card. You can detach any number of materials from this card, then target 1 DARK monster in your GY or banishment with a Level equal to the number detached; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Shamanite Shamanknight" once per turn.

cards.name: Cerynemesia, Mystical Beast of the Forest
cards.text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can banish (face-up) 1 Beast monster from your hand or face-up field until the End Phase; Special Summon 1 EARTH Beast monster from your Deck or GY, with an equal or lower Level than that monster's original Level, then your opponent can Special Summon 1 monster from their hand. You can only use this effect of "Cerynemesia, Mystical Beast of the Forest" once per turn. Your opponent's monsters that can attack must attack the monster you control with the highest ATK (their choice, if tied).

cards.name: Imposter Shift
cards.text: When a monster effect that was activated on your opponent's field by targeting a card(s) on the field resolves, if any of those targets are in a different column than that opponent's monster, they can banish 1 card from their GY. If they did not, negate the activated effect. You can banish 1 monster from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Imposter Token" (Psychic/EARTH/ATK 800/DEF 800) with the same Level as that monster. You can only use this effect of "Imposter Shift" once per turn.

cards.name: Mortilux Heruvur
cards.text:
2+ Level 8 monsters
If a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; attach it to this card. You can only use this effect of "Mortilux Heruvur" once per turn. This card gains effects based on the number of materials attached to it.
● 2+: Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.
● 3+: Your opponent cannot target cards in the GYs with card effects.
● 4+: You can detach 3 materials from this card; send 1 monster on the field to the GY.

cards.name: Angelechy Shatranga
cards.text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish it. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can add 1 "Angelechy" Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Shatranga" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, your opponent can only attempt to activate up to 5 monster effects per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Bastion
cards.text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 other card in this card's column; banish it. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can place 1 "Angelechy Shatranga" from your Extra Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Bastion" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, other "Angelechy" cards on the field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

cards.name: Angelechy Destrier
cards.text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 monster in another column; banish it. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can add 1 "Angelechy" Spell from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Destrier" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, each time your opponent activates a card or effect, inflict 500 damage to your opponent when it resolves.

cards.name: Angelechy Enlisted
cards.text:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner
You can target 1 opponent's monster in this card's adjacent column; banish it, then change control of this card by moving it to one of your opponent's Main Monster Zones in this card's adjacent columns. If the control of this face-up card changes: Return this card to the Extra Deck, then the owner of this card Special Summons 1 "Angelechy" monster from their Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Enlisted" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Problem
cards.text: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Spell/Trap; Special Summon 1 Level 2 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck, and if you do, place 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck to your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. If a face-up "Angelechy" Monster Card(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can return 1 "Angelechy" Monster Card you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it.

cards.name: Angelechy Disturbance
cards.text: Give control of 1 "Angelechy" monster you control to your opponent (until the End Phase), then if your opponent controls a face-up card(s) in its adjacent Monster Zones and/or Spell & Trap Zones, their effects are negated. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Angelechy" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Angelechy Disturbance". You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Disturbance" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Opening to e4
cards.text: If your opponent goes first, you can also activate this card from your hand during the Standby Phase of their first turn. Place 1 "Angelechy" Field Spell from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up on your field, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 2 or 7 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck to the Extra Monster Zone, and if you do that, place 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. Until the end of your next turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters.

cards.name: Ignihorse Dragonis
cards.text: ''A draco-horse racing around freely upon the boiling sea. It continues to run on the water surface today in order to prevent its own flames from extinguishing. It dreams of one day setting foot upon its homeland.''

cards.name: Stealth Angecradle
cards.text: ''A mysterious entity known as "the angel that brings salvation to heretical souls". The only thing left behind after "that thing" passes through is eternal silence... Ange Passe.''

cards.name: Possessed Destiny - Wynn
cards.text:
1 Spellcaster monster + 1 WIND monster
(This card is always treated as a "Familiar-Possessed" card.)
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can place 1 WIND monster from your GY on the bottom of the Deck, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of that monster. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can target 2 cards on the field, including a WIND monster you control; place them on the bottom of the Deck in any order. You can only use 1 "Possessed Destiny - Wynn" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: The Three Champions of Swordsoul
cards.text:
1 Level 4 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can add 1 Level 4 or 8 Spellcaster monster whose ATK equals its own DEF from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can target 1 face-up card on the field; negate its effects, then if you have an "Ecclesia" monster or "Fallen of Albaz" in your GY, you can destroy that card. You can only use each effect of "The Three Brave Swordsouls" once per turn.

cards.name: Gorgon of Zilofthonia
cards.text:
2+ Effect Monsters
You cannot Summon/Set monsters to a zone(s) this card points to. Monsters this card points to cannot attack, also their activated effects are negated. cards.text: Return up to 2 cards from the field to the hand, then each player places cards from their hand on the bottom of their Deck, in any order, equal to the number returned to their hand. You can only activate 1 "Hey, Space Trunade!" per turn.

cards.name: Spell Power Attainment
cards.text:
Add 1 card that mentions "Spell Counter" in its effect text from your Deck or GY to your hand, except "Spell Power Attainment", then if you control a Level 7 or higher "Endymion" Monster Card, you can apply this effect.
● Remove any number of Spell Counters from your field, and if you do, negate the effects of that many face-up cards your opponent controls, and if you do that, destroy those cards.
You can only activate 1 "Spell Power Attainment" per turn.

cards.name: Foolish Graverobber
cards.text:
Send 1 card that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck to the GY, except "Foolish Graverobber", then you can Special Summon 1 monster from either GY to your field. You can banish this card from your GY; Set 1 of the following cards to your field.
● Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" in your GY, except "Foolish Graverobber"
● Spell/Trap in your opponent's GY
You can only use each effect of "Foolish Graverobber" once per turn.

cards.name: Reversal Box
cards.text: Once per turn, during the Standby Phase: Roll a six-sided die, and place counters on this card (max. 6), up to the result. When a monster effect is activated on your opponent's field, or once per battle, during damage calculation, if your opponent's monster attacks: You can remove 1 counter from this card, then target 1 of those monsters; toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck, and if you do, until the end of this turn, change the targeted monster's ATK to 0, also negate its effects.

cards.name: Barian's Seal
cards.text: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, while you control a "CXyz" monster, or a monster with "Number C101" through "Number C107" in its name: Negate that activation, then you can attach 1 monster from the field or either GY to 1 Xyz Monster you control. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 2 "Umbral Horror" monsters from your GY. You can only use 1 "Barian's Seal" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Ashtra's Web
cards.text:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Insect/Tuner/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster.
● Target 1 "Ashtra" monster in your GY; Special Summon it.

cards.name: Ashtra's Howl
cards.text:

cards.name: Ashtra's Domain
cards.text:
Activate 1 of these effects;

You can only activate 1 "Ashtra's Domain" per turn.

cards.name: Daedalus Maelstrom
cards.text: When your opponent would Normal or Special Summon a monster(s), while you control "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon": Negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster(s), then if you control a WATER Link Monster, you can destroy all monsters on the field, except WATER monsters. You can banish this card from your GY and send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; send it to the GY. You can only use 1 "Daedalus Maelstrom" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Ars Magna "Philosophorum"
cards.text: Target up to 3 "Ars Magna" monsters in your field or GY; banish them, then until the end of this turn, you can negate the effects of up to that many other face-up cards on the field. You can only use 1 "Ars Magna "Philosophorum"" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Revenge of the Paper Dolls
cards.text: Target 1 monster you control and 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy your monster, and if you do, negate the effects of that opponent's card until the end of this turn. If this Set card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate its effects. You can only use each effect of "Revenge of the Paper Dolls" once per turn.

cards.name: Crow, the Carrion Cutpurse
cards.text:
Send the top cards of your Deck to the GY, up to the number of Traps with different names from each other in the GYs +1 (max. 4), then you can apply 1 of these effects.
● Special Summon 1 monster from among those cards.
● Set 1 Spell/Trap from among those cards, except "Crow, the Carrion Cutpurse". If you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn.

cards.name: Bingo!
Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse
cards.text: If 4 or more cards are on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can change this card to face-down Defense Position, also for the rest of this turn, all face-down cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, and your opponent cannot target them with card effects. You can only use each effect of "Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse" once per turn.

cards.name: Tigress in Silent Repose

If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can send 1 Spell/Trap you control to the GY; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Tigress in Silent Repose" once per turn.

cards.name: Just Flip a Coin
cards.text:
If a face-up card(s) you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, Special Summon 1 monster from your GY. If you call it wrong, Set 1 Trap from your GY. If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 monster from your GY.
● Set 1 Trap from your GY.
You can only use each effect of "Just Flip a Coin" once per turn.

cards.name: Kumenyo, the Nine-Hued Deer

2+ Level 4 LIGHT and/or DARK monsters

● 3+: Draw 2 cards instead of 1 for your normal draw during your Draw Phase.

cards.name: Kerolia the Frolicsome

cards.text:

● 5+: Banish all cards your opponent controls.
You can banish this card from your GY; send 1 "Angelechy" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY, then you can place 1 "Angelechy" monster with a different name than the cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, from your Extra Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Verdict" once per turn.

cards.name: Long-Tailed Black Horse

cards.text:
